A few things to know.

Who are the programs for?

The sample courses shown here introduce AI, web development, and Python to beginners. They demonstrate the website design and are not enrollment offers.

How does learning work?

Cre8TechIN describes a four-week project format with weekly mentor feedback, a GitHub repository, and digital completion credentials.

When does the next cohort begin?

These are showcase courses, so there is no scheduled cohort or enrollment. Visit the official Cre8TechIN programs page for actual offerings.

Are these real student projects?

The three interactive projects on this page are concepts. The personalized ID is a browser-only preview, and the workshop image is an illustration.

Where do I enroll or ask about refunds?

Continue to the official programs page ↗. Confirm fees, eligibility, support contact, and refund terms with Cre8TechIN before payment.
